name: DevOps
description: Shipping software continuously: automation, CI/CD, deployment strategies, infrastructure as code and observability.

nodes.name: DevOps culture
nodes.desc: Breaking down silos, shared ownership, DORA metrics and fast feedback.
nodes.summary: You will be able to explain how DevOps breaks down silos through shared ownership and fast feedback and measure delivery with DORA metrics.

nodes.name: Everything in Git
nodes.desc: Everything in version control: code, config and infrastructure.
nodes.summary: You will be able to keep code, configuration and infrastructure in version control and use branching and review workflows to change them safely.

nodes.name: Automation scripting
nodes.desc: Automating repetitive tasks with shell and Python scripts.
nodes.summary: You will be able to automate repetitive operational tasks with robust shell and Python scripts.

nodes.name: Build automation
nodes.desc: Reproducible builds, dependency management and build caching.
nodes.summary: You will be able to create reproducible builds with pinned dependencies and build caching.

nodes.name: CI/CD
nodes.desc: Continuous integration and delivery pipelines from commit to deploy.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build continuous integration and delivery pipelines that take a commit through build, test and deploy stages.

nodes.name: Tests in the pipeline
nodes.desc: Unit, integration and security scans as pipeline stages and quality gates.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run unit, integration and security scans as pipeline stages with quality gates that block bad changes.

nodes.name: Artifacts & registries
nodes.desc: Versioned build artifacts, container registries and promotion between environments.
nodes.summary: You will be able to version build artifacts, store them in registries and promote the same artifact between environments.

nodes.name: Blue-green & canary
nodes.desc: Rolling, blue-green and canary deployments and rollbacks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to release safely with rolling, blue-green and canary deployments and roll back quickly when problems appear.

nodes.name: Feature flags
nodes.desc: Decoupling deploy from release with feature flags.
nodes.summary: You will be able to decouple deployment from release using feature flags for gradual rollouts and quick kill switches.

nodes.name: GitOps
nodes.desc: Declarative deployments reconciled from a Git repository.
nodes.summary: You will be able to run declarative deployments that a controller continuously reconciles from a Git repository.

nodes.name: Infrastructure as code
nodes.desc: Provisioning infrastructure declaratively, plans, state and modules.
nodes.summary: You will be able to provision infrastructure declaratively, review plans, manage state and reuse modules.

nodes.name: Config management
nodes.desc: Configuring servers with tools like Ansible and immutable infrastructure.
nodes.summary: You will be able to configure servers with tools like Ansible and explain when immutable infrastructure is the better choice.

nodes.name: Secrets management
nodes.desc: Storing and injecting secrets safely in pipelines and runtime.
nodes.summary: You will be able to store secrets securely and inject them into pipelines and running applications without leaking them.
topics: Why secrets stay out of code

nodes.name: Monitoring & metrics
nodes.summary: You will be able to collect metrics, build dashboards and define SLIs and SLOs that reflect user experience.

nodes.name: Logging
nodes.summary: You will be able to produce structured logs and aggregate and search them centrally.

nodes.name: Alerting & on-call
nodes.desc: Actionable alerts, on-call rotations and runbooks.
nodes.summary: You will be able to write actionable alerts, organise on-call rotations and support responders with runbooks.

nodes.name: Incidents & SRE
nodes.desc: Incident handling, blameless postmortems and error budgets.
nodes.summary: You will be able to handle incidents, run blameless postmortems and use error budgets to balance reliability and speed.

nodes.name: CI/CD pipeline project
nodes.desc: Build a full pipeline that tests, packages and deploys an app with automatic rollback.
nodes.summary: You will build a complete pipeline that tests, packages and deploys an application with automatic rollback on failure.

nodes.name: Observable service
nodes.desc: Provision a service with code, add dashboards and alerts, and run an incident drill.
nodes.summary: You will provision a service with infrastructure as code, add dashboards and alerts, and run an incident drill against it.
